name: chemical-review
description: An iterative research-companion workflow for critical narrative chemical literature reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Iteratively develop a critical chemical literature review.
interface.longDescription: Treats the model as a research companion across Grill, Research, Prototype, PRD, Issues, Implement, and Review, with human feedback routed into later iterations. It does not claim scientific validity or journal acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use $chemical-review to develop a critical chemical literature review.
Use $chemical-review to continue an existing review project.
Use $chemical-review to route human review feedback into the next iteration.
